Pre-release build for v0.2.0. Binaries are not code-signed. Check files against SHA256SUMS.txt. Install steps are in [docs/install.md](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/blob/v0.2.0/docs/install.md).

This release is the host only: a Linux x86_64 tarball and the `ghcr.io/pandaquq/robroz-host:v0.2.0` and `ghcr.io/pandaquq/robroz-runner:v0.2.0` images. The desktop and mobile clients are now released from [PandaQuQ/robroz-client](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client); use a client built against `contract-v0.3.1` or newer.

## Changes

- One-command install with Docker: `deploy/install.sh` writes a Compose file, a local token and `.env`, then starts the host on `127.0.0.1:8790`. A rerun upgrades without touching `.env`, the token or `data/` ([#197](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/197), [#204](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/204)).
- A group message that mentions no bro gets one reply, from one bro picked by the host, instead of a turn for every bro ([#198](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/198)).
- Bro owners: only a bro's owner can rename it, open its DM, add it to a group or answer its approval cards ([#174](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/174)).
- Optional bro avatar, a shape and a colour picked by the owner ([#194](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/194)).
- Group member list, rename, delete and in-group search ([#195](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/195)).
- Machine codes for status, failures, progress, approval reasons and request errors, so clients write their own text in each language ([#178](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/178), [#186](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/186), [#187](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/187), [#189](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/189)).
- The live stream resumes from a change log, so a reconnect no longer misses cards; streams have a keepalive, a maximum age and a connection limit, and noisy progress is throttled ([#202](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/202), [#203](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/203)).
- Stdio MCP servers stay running between tasks, one process per server per group ([#188](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/188), [#190](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/190)).
- `robroz-host --version` and a host Docker image with a health check ([#170](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/170), [#191](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/191), [#204](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/204)).

Full list in [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md).

## Client (robroz-client)

The matching client is released from robroz-client. Changes so far:

- Centred chat column, new message bubbles and composer ([client#7](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client/pull/7)).
- Text for failure, progress and approval reason codes in English and Chinese; an unknown code shows a generic line and logs the raw value ([client#8](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client/pull/8)).
- Bro avatars, a create-bro page and a title capsule; only the owner sees the avatar editor ([client#9](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client/pull/9)).
- The process line folds to one row per turn, a working row above the composer, a timer on status cards, and a quiet reconnect that shows "Reconnecting…" only after 30 seconds of failures ([client#10](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client/pull/10)).
- New home list with search, a floating top bar with an unread count on the back button, a group ••• menu and a group profile page. Rename, members and delete group show only to the group's creator or an admin, and never in a DM ([client#11](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client/pull/11)).

## Upgrading from v0.1.x

- Bros from a v0.1 database are owned by the bootstrap admin (the env token).
- The host still has a single token, so every caller is the bootstrap admin. Per-user tokens and group lists filtered by membership are planned for v0.3.
- To keep every bro answering a message that names nobody, set `ROBROZ_SINGLE_RESPONDER=0`.
- `failureDetail` is raw data (for example `500` or `3/2`), not a sentence to show as it is.
- Answering an approval card that is already decided, expired or not yours is 403 `approval_forbidden`, not 409.
- SSE `id:` values are now opaque decimal cursors. Send the last one back as `Last-Event-ID`; ids from an older host still resume.
- Rerunning `deploy/install.sh` tightens `data/` to 0700 and the database to 0600.

## Requirements

- Linux binaries are built on Ubuntu 22.04. The host needs glibc 2.34 or newer. The images are linux/amd64 only.
- The install script needs rootful Docker with the default socket and `docker compose`. The install path must be ASCII.

## Known issues

- A pending card whose bro was deleted can be approved or denied by any signed-in user; only an admin will be able to in v0.3, and deleting a bro will expire its pending cards ([#206](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/206)).
- The MCP server endpoints (`/api/mcp/servers`, `/test`, `/tools`) do not check the caller's role. The v0.2 host has a single token, so this has no effect yet; it is fixed with per-user tokens in v0.3.

## 中文

v0.2.0 预发布版本。二进制文件没有代码签名，下载后请用 SHA256SUMS.txt 校验。安装步骤见 [docs/install.md](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/blob/v0.2.0/docs/install.md)。

这次只发 host：Linux x86_64 压缩包，以及 `ghcr.io/pandaquq/robroz-host:v0.2.0` 和 `ghcr.io/pandaquq/robroz-runner:v0.2.0` 两个镜像。桌面和手机客户端改在 [PandaQuQ/robroz-client](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client) 发布，请用基于 `contract-v0.3.1` 或更新版本构建的客户端。

### 更新内容

- 用 Docker 一条命令安装：`deploy/install.sh` 写好 Compose 文件、本地生成的 token 和 `.env`，然后在 `127.0.0.1:8790` 启动 host。重跑就是升级，不动 `.env`、token 和 `data/`（[#197](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/197)、[#204](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/204)）。
- 群消息里没 @ 任何 bro 时，由 host 选一个 bro 回，不再每个 bro 都回一遍（[#198](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/198)）。
- bro 主人：只有主人能改 bro 的名字、打开它的私聊、把它拉进群、处理它的审批卡（[#174](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/174)）。
- 可选的 bro 头像，由主人选形状和颜色（[#194](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/194)）。
- 群成员列表、改群名、删群、群内搜索（[#195](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/195)）。
- 状态、失败原因、进度、审批原因和请求错误都改成编码，客户端按语言自己出文案（[#178](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/178)、[#186](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/186)、[#187](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/187)、[#189](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/189)）。
- 实时事件流按变更日志续传，断线重连不会再漏卡片；流有 keepalive、最长时长和连接数上限，刷屏的进度会被限频（[#202](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/202)、[#203](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/203)）。
- stdio MCP 服务在任务之间保持运行，每台服务器每个群一个进程（[#188](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/188)、[#190](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/190)）。
- `robroz-host --version`，以及带健康检查的 host Docker 镜像（[#170](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/170)、[#191](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/191)、[#204](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/204)）。

完整列表见 [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/blob/v0.2.0/CHANGELOG.md)。

### 客户端（robroz-client）

配套的客户端在 robroz-client 发布。目前的改动：

- 聊天栏居中，消息气泡和输入框改版（[client#7](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client/pull/7)）。
- 失败、进度和审批原因按编码出中英文文案；不认识的编码显示一句通用提示，原始值记进日志（[client#8](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client/pull/8)）。
- bro 头像、新建 bro 页面和标题胶囊；只有主人能看到改头像的入口（[client#9](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client/pull/9)）。
- 过程每轮折叠成一行，输入框上方显示谁在处理，状态卡带计时；断线静默重连，连续失败超过 30 秒才显示「正在重新连接」（[client#10](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client/pull/10)）。
- 新首页列表和搜索，悬浮顶栏，返回键带未读数，群 ••• 菜单和群资料页。改名、成员、删除群只对建群的人或管理员显示，私聊里一律不显示（[client#11](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz-client/pull/11)）。

### 从 v0.1.x 升级

- v0.1 数据库里已有的 bro 归 bootstrap 管理员（即环境变量里的 token）所有。
- host 仍然只有一个 token，所有调用者都是 bootstrap 管理员。每个用户单独的 token、按成员过滤群列表，放到 v0.3。
- 想让没 @ 人的消息仍然每个 bro 都回，设 `ROBROZ_SINGLE_RESPONDER=0`。
- `failureDetail` 是原始数据（比如 `500`、`3/2`），不是能直接显示的句子。
- 处理已经处理过、已过期或不属于你的审批卡，返回 403 `approval_forbidden`，不再是 409。
- SSE 的 `id:` 改成不透明的十进制游标。重连时把最后一个原样放进 `Last-Event-ID`；旧版 host 的 id 也能续上。
- 重跑 `deploy/install.sh` 会把 `data/` 收紧到 0700、数据库收紧到 0600。

### 系统要求

- Linux 版本在 Ubuntu 22.04 上构建。host 需要 glibc 2.34 或更高。镜像只有 linux/amd64。
- 安装脚本需要 rootful Docker、默认的 socket 路径和 `docker compose`。安装路径只能用 ASCII。

### 已知问题

- bro 被删后，它留下的待审批卡任何登录用户都能批准或拒绝；v0.3 改为只有 admin 能批，删除 bro 时也会把它的待审批卡标为过期（[#206](https://github.com/PandaQuQ/robroz/pull/206)）。
- MCP 服务器接口（`/api/mcp/servers`、`/test`、`/tools`）不检查调用者角色。v0.2 的 host 只有一个令牌，目前没有影响；v0.3 引入每用户令牌时一起修。
